The desk cannot run this without access.
No `version` statement in any do-file. Stata's behaviour depends on the version, so a rerun must choose one and log it.
R code loads data.table, foreign, psidR with no renv.lock. A rerun installs current CRAN versions and must log them.
Do-files install ineqdeco, lorenz, mat2txt, scheme-burd from the network at run time, with no version pinned and no copy bundled. SSC serves the current version, which may differ from the authors'.

`skill_premium\ACS_college\ACS_college.dta` is not in the package; the documentation (README.md, inputs_stata_code/skill_premium/ACS_college/README.md) says it comes from a source that needs registration ("IPUMS"). The desk must register, download and log the extract.

`$resultspath/$variant_base/population.csv` is not in the package; the documentation (README.md, SCENARIOS.md) says it comes from a source that needs registration ("IPUMS"). The desk must register, download and log the extract.

`..\data\PSID\psid_ready.dta` is not in the package; the documentation (README.md, inputs_stata_code/income_process/PSID/README.md) says it comes from a source that needs registration ("IPUMS"). The desk must register, download and log the extract.
`..\data\SCF\SCF_plus.dta` is not in the package; the documentation (README.md) says it comes from a source that needs registration ("IPUMS"). The desk must register, download and log the extract.
1 code lines use absolute paths from the authors' machines. A rerun must edit them, and each edit is a logged deviation.
Requires Matlab; the desk says it has it.
Requires Stata; the desk says it has it.

Files the code both writes and reads are already in the package: ../graphs/outputs/wealth_inequality/combined_gini.dta, bone.dta, bone1y.dta, data/avghours_data.dta, data/benefits_cbo.dta, data/irr_data.dta, demography\hetero_pi\processed\hetero_pi.dta, demography\hetero_pi\processed\pi_col_merge_M.dta, demography\mortality\processed\mortality_part_00.dta, demography\mortality\processed\mortality_part_11.dta. A run may read these instead of recomputing them. A receipt must say whether it replayed them or recomputed them, and a matching output hash alone does not show recomputation.
36 file reads use paths built at run time (macros, globs, variables), so triage could not check that those inputs exist.
